items.name: ds-button
items.title: Button
items.description: DeesseJS button — Base UI primitive on shadcn base-nova tokens, with variant and size styles.

items.name: ds-icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: DeesseJS icon-only button — Base UI primitive with sm/md/lg size variants and required aria-label.

items.name: ds-colored-badge
items.title: Colored Badge
items.description: DeesseJS badge with semantic color variants (blue, green, red, yellow, orange, purple, pink, gray). Self-contained — no Base UI dependency.

items.name: ds-breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: DeesseJS hierarchical navigation trail — Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator, BreadcrumbEllipsis. Uses Base UI useRender for polymorphic link + lucide-react icons.

items.name: ds-empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: DeesseJS composable empty-state placeholder — Empty, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription, EmptyContent. No Base UI dependency.

items.name: ds-tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: DeesseJS tabbed content on the Base UI Tabs primitive — Tabs, TabsList (default/line variants), TabsTrigger, TabsContent. Horizontal and vertical orientations.

items.name: ds-input
items.title: Input
items.description: DeesseJS single-line text input with token-driven borders, focus ring, aria-invalid styling. Self-contained — no Base UI dependency.

items.name: ds-textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: DeesseJS multi-line textarea with token-driven borders, focus ring, aria-invalid styling. Self-contained — no Base UI dependency.

items.name: ds-block-empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: DeesseJS composable empty-state block — bundles ds-empty + ds-button + ds-colored-badge. Optional icon, status badge, description, and CTA. First block, single-file, validates the registry:block pipeline.
